answer: Post a bond per identity and cap each identity's payout per epoch, so a fleet earns linearly and never scales into a whale. The cap is the whole point: 1,000 aliases at 1 unit each earn 1,000, but so do 20 real identities doing 50 units of work, and the 1,000 need 1,000 bonds. Cost of the fake route is 1,000 bonds plus the vault space to hold them, and the velvet of a big fleet number is worth nothing at the vertex of the payout curve.
